params.content_sha256: sha256 hex of raw `text` field, utf-8, as-is
params.corpus_fingerprint: sha256 over newline-joined sorted per-row hashes
params.near_normalize: lowercase; strip URLs/@handles; drop non-[a-z0-9\s]; collapse whitespace
params.non_english_rule: rows with >=1 alpha char where ascii(a-z)/alpha < 0.5
